description: This file defines the Toaster utility class for displaying customized toast messages (success and error) within the WeatherApp Android project.
external_methods: Toasty.custom(Context, String, int, String, int, String)

classes.name: Toaster
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to display success and error toast messages with custom styling.
